en:
<CLT=cltMIND>Something in the center of the room caught
my eye, and I couldn't help but shout...
<CLT=cltMIND>Smiling, I ran toward it and lifted the cover.

<CLT=cltMIND>Beneath it, a clean row of black-and-white keys
smiled back at me.

<CLT=cltMIND>I haven't touched a piano in a couple days, but
it feels like it's been forever since I played.
Hahaha... I really am the Piano Freak...

<CLT=cltMIND>Looks like I can use it to play the CDs
on the wall.

<CLT=cltMIND>There are a bunch of CDs lined up on the
shelves. Most of them are classical music.

<CLT=cltMIND>The works of minor and major composers from
various eras and countries are all here.

<CLT=cltMIND>I was concerned at first...but someone
has clearly been taking good care of it.

<CLT=cltMIND>It's a monitor for communicating with us...
But there's nothing displayed right now.
